title: refactor(objectql): ObjectQL#insert's body moves into its facet (codemod R10 keeps a module's other engine.js names)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9KX9KQPGPGgUsuSjbwJeH77)_

Refs #30020

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：把查询引擎 `ObjectQL` 里 `insert`（新建记录）的方法体原封不动地搬进同一节的 facet 模块 `engine-insert.ts`，类上只留一行转调；搬移工具 codemod 放宽了两条规则（R10 改道时保留模块已有的其他 `./engine.js` 导入名；R4 遇到模块已导入的名字不再拒绝），并删掉门禁登记表里 `insert` 这一行例外。
- **为什么改**：#30020 拆分大文件 `engine.ts` 的既定顺序第六步（E5）。`engine-insert.ts` 的 `./engine.js` 导入行还带着 `InsertManyRowOutcome`，原工具只认单独一行 `import type { ObjectQL }`，所以拒绝搬；补上后由工具确定性生成，不手搬。
- **风险与回滚**：纯搬移：发布的 `.d.ts` 逐字节不变，同样的语句按同样顺序执行；undo 证明逐字节还原 base。所有新建路径（REST、流程、导入、种子）都经过它，dogfood 全量已跑绿。回滚即整体 revert。
- **先看**：① `packages/objectql/src/engine-insert.ts` 文件头的 import 对和 host 接口 ② `scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs` 的 `engineRunOf` / `rerouteModule` 和 R4 那段 ③ 三处被迫跟着改路径的地方（见下文 Forced edits）。
- **两分钟验证**：`node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --members --verify --base $(git merge-base origin/main HEAD)`，预期打印 `undoing the moves does rebuild the base engine.ts and its modules byte-for-byte`，退出码 0。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`ObjectQL#insert` moves into its facet** (`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` → `engine-insert.ts`), generated by `node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --members insert --write` on `main` `630a0baa`, then `main` `a15b544d` merged in (merge commit, no conflict). The stub keeps its docblock and signature. The bare `this` the body hands on reads `this.facade` (R1): `ql: this.facade` in the hook context and the ownership-queue slot read. The body's one static read, `ObjectQL.homeAmountOrganizationOf`, goes through the existing `ObjectQLStatics` forwarder: R10 puts `engine-insert.ts` on the statics route. `engine.ts` 10018 → 8692 lines; 13 import bindings only the moved body read are pruned from it. The after-abort re-entry (`this.inAfterAbortUnit(() => this.insert(...))`) moves with the body; the swallow census has no `insert` control, and `check:swallow-census-controls` stays green.
- **Codemod: R10 keeps the module's other `./engine.js` names; R4 reads a name a routed module already imports** (`scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs`). On `main` the fourth pass refused this move: `engine-insert.ts: its ./engine.js import is not the one import type { ObjectQL } from './engine.js'; a module off the statics route carries`. That file's first-pass line is `import type { InsertManyRowOutcome, ObjectQL } from './engine.js';`. R10 now reads the whole `./engine.js` run (`engineRunOf`) and requires it to be exactly `importPair`'s form: the class type-only, every other name plain. It writes the statics pair in the class's place beside the same names, and the undo writes them back. Next the pass refused again: `insert reads InsertManyRowOutcome, a name engine.ts exports, and engine-insert.ts takes the statics route`. R4 into a routed module now passes a name the module's `./engine.js` line already imports, in a form that serves the read. Nothing is imported in that case, and `moduleImportEdits` skips the name. A name the module does not import still refuses, as before.
- **`scripts/facade-delegation-registry.json`**: the `ObjectQL` · `insert` row (#30020, bare-this) leaves; no other row moves. `check:facade-delegation-only` 8 → 7 named exceptions.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/30020-objectql-insert-facet.md`, `@objectstack/objectql` patch, as for E2/S1/E4. The `.d.ts` is unchanged but the published JS changes (positive control below).

## Forced edits (seat ruling: forced edits only, path re-points, nothing else)

Each one is a gate or test that reads `insert`'s location from source and went red after the move:

| File | Required by | Red on the move | Edit |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `packages/objectql/src/validate-preview-parent.test.ts` | objectql suite, `#22474 (f) — parity` | `expected 3 to be greater than or equal to 4` (it parses the write-side `evaluateValidationRules` calls out of `engine.ts`; two were `insert`'s) | `engine-insert.ts` joins the file list it reads, as #25522 cut 16 added `engine-validate.ts`; comment updated; no assertion changed |
| `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` | `pnpm check:system-context-census` | `[register-drift]` and `[anchor-is-not-a-read-site] the page anchors packages/objectql/src/engine.ts#insert` | the generated register row (`--write`) and one row's anchor cell: `engine.ts#insert` → `engine-insert.ts#insert` (the 3 elevation reads moved with the body; same counts, same row keys 21, 22) |
| `scripts/check-system-context-census.mjs` | `pnpm check:system-context-census` | `[ledger-stale-collapse] NON_READ_ANCHORS row for packages/objectql/src/engine.ts#insert` | that row's `file` → `engine-insert.ts`; symbol and `why` unchanged |

Overlap note: open #31867 also edits `system-context.mdx` (its row 23g and two new register rows). The hunks are different, and `git merge-tree` of this head with #31867's head is clean. The register region is `merge=os-regen`.

## Tests

- Three new self-test cases in the battery `statics route for a written module (fourth pass, #30020 R10)` (floor 18 → 21):
  - A module whose `./engine.js` line carries other plain names is rerouted, keeping them beside the pair.
  - R10 undoes that reroute byte-for-byte.
  - R4 of a name a routed module already imports needs no edit.
- Two existing cases were re-aimed at the shapes that still refuse, since a line with other plain names is now a valid shape:
  - The wrong-pair head uses a value-imported `ObjectQLClass`.
  - The not-first-pass-form refusal uses a hand-spaced import.

<details><summary>Ablations (each red, then restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty)</summary>

Via `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs … -- node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --self-test`:

| Mutation | Red cases |
|:--|:--|
| R4 held-name pass off in `planMembers` | 1: `R4 of a name a routed module already imports … needs no edit there — staticReader reads Scoped, a name engine.ts exports, and engine-identity.ts takes the statics route` |
| held-name skip off in `moduleImportEdits` | 1: same case — `the imports of ./engine.js are not as the first pass wrote them` |
| R10 refuses a run with other names (`run.others.size > 0`) | 3: the reroute-keeps-names case, its undo, and the R4 case |
| R10's first-pass-form check off | 1: `a module whose ./engine.js import is not as the first pass writes it refuses the route` |

</details>

## Verification

All heavy readings went through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, each with `VERDICT command-exit 0`. Base is `main` `a15b544d`; head is `5b489a9e`.

| Run | Base | Head |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --members --verify --base origin/main` (a15b544d) | — | exit 0; 1 moved (`insert`), byte-exact, 13 bindings pruned |
| codemod `--self-test` | 229 cases / 14 batteries | 232 cases / 14 batteries |
| `pnpm check:facade-delegation-only` | 8 exceptions | 7 exceptions |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` | — | exit 0 |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test` | 580 files / 11944 tests | 580 files / 11944 tests |
| objectql `dist` `.d.ts` (`core`, `index`, `util-*`, `.d.ts` + `.d.mts`) | — | byte-identical to base (`cmp`) |
| JS positive control: `InsertFacet.insert.call` in `dist/index.mjs` | 0 | 1 |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` (full, no shard) | — | 442 passed, 3 skipped files / 3669 passed, 42 skipped tests |
| `eslint --no-inline-config` on `engine.ts`, `engine-insert.ts`, the codemod (objectql has no `lint` script) | — | exit 0 |

<details><summary>Derived gates: 120 / 120 on head 5b489a9e, reconciled</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `5b489a9e` derived 120 commands. The docs page puts the docs families in scope, so the count is up from 81 before the forced edits. All 120 ran after a full `pnpm build`, each exit 0. `--ran`: "120 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 120 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)". On the first round (head `55ce44da`, 81 derived) one gate was red, `check:system-context-census`, and so was the objectql parity test. The forced edits above fixed both. Census, swallow-census controls and the codemod self-test were re-run after the `main` merge.

</details>

`test:repo` was not run locally (no diff in that project); CI's Test Core carries it.
